Dear Customer Support Team,

- Please provide the missing invoices for booking_12345 and insurance_12345.  
- Clarify the currency conversion applied to booking_403 and confirm whether the $30 difference is correct.  
- Verify that the insurance charge has been correctly applied to the appropriate booking and that no duplicate charges exist.  

I would appreciate it if you could investigate these matters at your earliest convenience. If you require any additional information—such as my account details, booking confirmations, or credit card statements—please let me know, and I will provide them promptly.

Best regards,
